name: En-ROADS Climate Solutions Simulator
description: En-ROADS is an interactive climate simulation model that allows users to explore the impact of policy decisions on global temperature and emissions. It integrates energy, economic, and climate systems into a unified model. The benchmark evaluates scenario-based reasoning and policy trade-offs.
reputation: Widely used in education, policy discussions, and climate workshops globally.
notes: Not designed as a benchmark for ML models; primarily an educational simulation tool.
